overview_description: List, read, delete and pay pro-forma invoices, the advance bills sent before a final invoice.
intro: A pro-forma invoice is an advance bill that can be paid before the final invoice. This area has 4 endpoints: list pro-forma invoices, retrieve one, delete one, and record a payment against one. Every SDK supports all of them.
notes: **Identify a pro-forma invoice by its code.** The same code comes back as both `id` and `invoice_id`.
**The listing shows only active ones.** Only pro-forma invoices whose invoice status is active are listed, under `data`, paged by cursor.
**A paid pro-forma invoice cannot be deleted.** The delete is refused with `400` and the code `already_paid`.
**Paying returns a short confirmation, not the payment.** The body under `payment` carries `object`, `payment_id` with the new payment's code, and `message`.

endpoints.title: List pro-forma invoices
endpoints.summary: Returns one page of pro-forma invoices whose invoice status is active.
endpoints.description: Lists pro-forma invoices one page at a time, under `data`, paged by cursor. Only pro-forma invoices whose invoice status is active are listed. To filter, add `filter_<field>=<value>`, or `filter_<field>_<operator>=<value>` with an operator such as `gte` or `contains`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The most records to return on one page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `next_cursor` value from the previous page, to fetch the page after it.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: The field to sort by. Put `-` in front for descending order, such as `-created_on`.

200.description: One page of pro-forma invoices, under `data`, with `pagination`.

endpoints.title: Retrieve a pro-forma invoice
endpoints.summary: Returns one pro-forma invoice by its code.
endpoints.description: Fetches a single pro-forma invoice by its code.

parameters.name: proforma_id
parameters.description: The pro-forma invoice's code, which it returns as both `id` and `invoice_id`.

endpoints.title: Delete a pro-forma invoice
endpoints.summary: Deletes a pro-forma invoice that has not been paid.
endpoints.description: Deletes the pro-forma invoice. One that has been paid is refused with `400` and the code `already_paid`.

parameters.name: proforma_id
parameters.description: The pro-forma invoice's code, which it returns as both `id` and `invoice_id`.

204.description: The pro-forma invoice is deleted. The response has no body.

400.description: The pro-forma invoice is already paid (`already_paid`).

endpoints.title: Pay a pro-forma invoice
endpoints.summary: Records a payment against a pro-forma invoice and returns the new payment's code.
endpoints.description: Takes a payment for the pro-forma invoice from the fields under `payment`. The fields this body takes are not documented yet; the sample shows only the required `payment` wrapper. The response is not the payment itself: it carries `object`, `payment_id` with the new payment's code, and a `message`, under `payment`.

parameters.name: proforma_id
parameters.description: The pro-forma invoice's code, which it returns as both `id` and `invoice_id`.

payment.description: The payment's fields. They are not documented yet.

201.description: The new payment's code as `payment.payment_id`, with `object` and `message`.

endpoints.warning: **This call has not been confirmed to work.** The fields the `payment` body takes are not documented yet.
